Hold a natural mortality array across seasons

expand_natmort_seasons.Rd

M is an instantaneous rate per year on a [n_pop x n_regions x n_years x n_seas x n_ages x n_sexes] grid. An array without the season dim gets kept at one rate across seasons, which is the model it came from. An array that already has it passes through.

Usage

expand_natmort_seasons(x, n_seas, seas_dim = 4, n_dim = 6)

Arguments

x

Natural mortality array, with or without seasons. NULL passes through.

n_seas

Number of seasons.

seas_dim

Where the season dim sits. 4 is the model's layout; the recruitment routines use a smaller grid with seasons third.

n_dim

Number of dims once seasons are there.

Value

An n_dim array with seasons in seas_dim.
